inlines.v: INCORRECT', adjective [in and correct.] Not correct; not exact; not according to a copy or model, or to established rules; inaccurate; faulty. The piece, you think, is incorrect 1. Not according to truth; inaccurate; as an incorrect statement, narration or calculation. 2. Not according to law or morality.
